title: Gemma Radiant Velvet Autumn

look.name: Gemma Harmonized Radiant Aura
look.reasoning: Dual-tone pairing: mirrors secondary accent #D9A566 with terracotta cheek contouring and berry lips against #801235 velvet.

makeup.eyes: Sculpted gold bronze cut crease with a crisp winged cat-eye accent.
makeup.cheeks: Duo-contour using terracotta bronzer topped with luminous liquid rose quartz highlighter.
makeup.lips: Satin berry velvet lip with defined Cupid's bow contouring.

tutorial_steps.title: Cheekbone Sculpt & Glow
tutorial_steps.instruction: Sweep blush along cheekbone apex, layering liquid pearl on the top crest.
tutorial_steps.pro_tip: Keep 2 finger widths away from nose.

tutorial_steps.title: Bronze Eyeshadow Dimension
tutorial_steps.instruction: Sweep warm gold bronze across eyelid crease and outer corner.

tutorial_steps.title: Precision Winged Eyeliner
tutorial_steps.instruction: Glide micro-felt tip from inner corner outward, creating a 45-degree wing.
tutorial_steps.pro_tip: Keep eyes open looking straight ahead.

tutorial_steps.title: Velvet Berry Lips
tutorial_steps.instruction: Define Cupid’s bow precisely and glide rich berry pigment across lips.
tutorial_steps.pro_tip: Use bullet tip for razor edges.

notes: Perfect match for the maroon saree with golden zari embroidery.
